visual.general_description: Color-mapped thyroid scintigraphy image captioned as Tc-99m pertechnetate thyroid scintigraphy.
visual.detailed_description: Figure 1 is a single blue-green speckled scintigraphic image with a butterfly-shaped distribution of two lobes, darker in the central parts, on a white background with two tiny unreadable black text marks. No scale, arrows or panel letters are printed.

panels.general_description: Single blue-green speckled nuclear scintigraphy image of a thyroid-shaped distribution on a white background, with two tiny black text marks.
panels.detailed_description: The image is a single color-mapped scan on a white background with no border, scale bar or colour bar. A speckled, grainy blue-green pattern forms a roughly butterfly or V-shaped area with two upright lobes at the top that join across a wider lower part, leaving a pale notch between the lobes at the top center. Intensity is lighter teal at the outer margins and the upper tips of the lobes and darker navy blue in the central parts of both lobes. The right lobe as viewed (right side of the image) has a darker, near-black elongated core in its middle, and the left-of-image lobe has a diffuse dark navy zone. The bottom of the shape is broad and blends into the white background. A tiny black text mark is printed in the white notch near the top center and another tiny black text mark near the bottom center below the shape; both are too small and blurred to read. No other text, arrows, patient details, date or timestamp are visible.

evidence.quote: Thyroid scintigraphy using technetium-99m pertechnetate revealed diffuse increased uptake consistent with toxic diffuse goiter ( Fig. 1 )

pixel_observations: Single color-mapped speckled image, blue-green on a white background, with no border, scale bar or colour bar.
Butterfly or V-shaped distribution with two upright lobes at the top joined by a wider lower part, with a pale notch between the lobes at the top center.
Lighter teal at the outer margins and lobe tips; darker navy in the central part of both lobes; a near-black elongated dark core in the middle of the lobe on the right side of the image.
Two tiny black text marks, one in the notch near the top center and one below the shape near the bottom center, too small and blurred to read.
No arrows, panel letters, numeric values, dates, names or other text are visible.

caption_claims.value: Caption states the image is thyroid scintigraphy using Tc-99m pertechnetate.

clinical_significance.statement: Authors present the scintigraphy as showing diffuse increased uptake consistent with toxic diffuse goiter, supporting the diagnosis of Graves' disease-associated psychosis.
